description_sq:
Penthouse 2+1+2 me Verande Private ne TEG!
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga rezidencat luksoze te zones se TEG, dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 139.2 m2. Hapesira eshte e organizuar me nje planimetri drejtkendore dhe shperndarje te rregullt. Hyrja ne apartament eshte e organizuar nepermjet korridorit i cili te percjell ne njerin krah ne dhomen e ndenjes dhe ambientit te gatimit, ndersa ne krahun tjeter vijon per tek dhomat e gjumit. Apartamenti ka dy tualete, nje nder te cilet eshte ne dhomen matrimoniale... 
Apartamenti ka dhe veranden e tij te aksesuar me shkalle te brendshme, ku perfshihen dhe nje Jacuzzi per 4 persona, si dhe panelet diellore. 
Apartamenti shitet i investuar bashke me punimet e gipsit dhe tavanet e varura. 
Objekti eshte i termoizoluar me sistem kapote dhe fasade me pllaka terrakote te cilesise me te larte. Dritaret termoizoluese jane me xham triplex dhe kane shtrirje te gjatesise deri ne dysheme, perfshire grila elektrike. 
Objekti ka parkun e tij qendror vetem per banoret e rezidences, si dhe hapesira te bollshme parkimi. Rezidenca eshte e rrethuar dhe do te kete monitorim te hapesires me kamera 24 ore ne dite. 
Objekti ka akses te menjehershem ne rruget e shpejtesise perreth, si dhe ndodhet fare prane qendres tregtare TEG. 
Prona disponon certifikate pronesie!
description_en: 2+1+2 Penthouse with Private Veranda in TEG! The apartment is located in one of the luxurious residences of the TEG area, and has a total area of ​​139.2 m2. The space is organized with a rectangular layout and regular distribution. The entrance to the apartment is organized through the corridor which leads to the living room and the kitchen on one side, while on the other side it leads to the bedrooms. The apartment has two toilets, one of which is in the master bedroom... The apartment also has its own veranda accessed by an internal staircase, which includes a Jacuzzi for 4 people, as well as solar panels. The apartment is sold as an investment along with plaster work and suspended ceilings. The building is thermally insulated with a hood system and a facade with terracotta tiles of the highest quality. The thermally insulating windows are triplex glass and extend to the floor, including electric shutters. The facility has its own central park only for residents of the residence, as well as ample parking spaces. The residence is surrounded and there will be monitoring of the space with cameras 24 hours a day. The facility has immediate access to the surrounding expressways, as well as being located very close to the TEG shopping center. The property has ownership certificates!
